title: Za’atar cod with relish
description: Add some spice to cod with the wonderful flavour of za'atar. Serve alongside homemade relish and rice or potatoes.

items.raw: 4 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for frying
items.name: olive oil, plus extra for frying

items.raw: 400g/14oz prime cod fillet or loin (or a different firm white fish), cut in to 4 pieces
items.name: /14oz prime cod fillet or loin (or a different firm white fish), cut in to 4 pieces

items.raw: 6 preserved lemons, halved and roughly chopped

steps.text: Mix the za’atar with the olive oil in a small bowl to create a paste. Smear this paste over the cod pieces, ensuring they are well coated. Season each piece of fish with a pinch of salt. Place in a non-reactive container and leave to marinade in the fridge for 30 minutes.
steps.raw: Mix the za’atar with the olive oil in a small bowl to create a paste. Smear this paste over the cod pieces, ensuring they are well coated. Season each piece of fish with a pinch of salt. Place in a non-reactive container and leave to marinade in the fridge for 30 minutes.

steps.text: For the relish, place all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Do not season the mixture with salt as it will already have a salty taste.
steps.raw: For the relish, place all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Do not season the mixture with salt as it will already have a salty taste.

steps.text: Heat a large frying pan over a medium heat, then drizzle in a generous amount of olive oil.
steps.raw: Heat a large frying pan over a medium heat, then drizzle in a generous amount of olive oil.

steps.text: Fry the cod for about 8 minutes on one side and 3-4 minutes on the other side. The cod should be golden-brown with a nice spice crusting.
steps.raw: Fry the cod for about 8 minutes on one side and 3-4 minutes on the other side. The cod should be golden-brown with a nice spice crusting.

steps.text: Serve the cod with a generous helping of the relish.
steps.raw: Serve the cod with a generous helping of the relish.

chefTips: To infuse the cod with more flavour you can allow it to marinade for longer than half an hour if you have time. You could marinade it overnight to make this a speedy supper for the following day.
